title: Governed current Production Hostinger build evidence R4

phases.objective: Collect one authenticated GET-only Hostinger build-history packet for the current protected Production rebuild through an explicitly dispatched, exact-head guarded workflow without performing any provider mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A repository-owner workflow dispatch or one exact governed Issue 4953 trigger comment carrying expected_head_sha
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A secret-free artifact and bounded Incident 4953 comment identify whether Hostinger created a build after the 2026-08-03T06:16:38Z Production rebuild and report its UUID, state, source SHA evidence, and first failure without changing Hostinger.
steps: Resolve an explicit expected_head_sha from workflow_dispatch input or the exact Issue 4953 trigger token.
Reject main and Production as repository mutation targets before any write.
Check out the exact authorized main head and prove remote main still equals expected_head_sha.
Verify authorization comment 5164305233, protected Production 5e5178bb, and canonical reporter blobs.
Reject prior claiming or completed use of the same immutable binding.
Record a bounded issue-only claim before accessing provider credentials.
Run the canonical reporter regression without provider credentials.
Perform authenticated GET-only Hostinger build-list inspection for auth.mad4b.com after the Production rebuild timestamp.
Scrub the exact provider token from every persisted JSON and Markdown file.
Upload the diagnostic packet and publish a bounded classification to Incident 4953.
assertions: The workflow declares workflow_dispatch and verifies an explicit expected_head_sha before any repository write.
Issue-comment execution is restricted to Incident 4953, the repository owner identity, the exact one-time token, and a full SHA.
The target account is u338416126 and the domain is auth.mad4b.com.
The expected Production SHA is 5e5178bb7d5b86fe42a5eb97e647a5d65edaaceb and the rebuild timestamp is 2026-08-03T06:16:38Z.
The canonical reporter and reporter-test blobs are fixed before credential access.

The provider method is GET only and no build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider POST, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force update, or external business send occurs.
The Hostinger API token is not returned in artifacts or incident comments.
Diagnostic outcomes including no build, pending, running, failed, other SHA, source-unverified, and reporter failure do not authorize restart.

phases.objective: Merge the inert registration, re-read main and Production, then post exactly one governed trigger and use the resulting build UUID and classification to choose completed-build log inspection or stop before restart.
